user_query: I'd like to explore the blog archive and read articles in Italian from the year 2021. Retrieve the blog posts using the Punto 61 API. Furthermore, search for the Skype user with the email address robert.smith@hotmail.com and provide me with their Skype ID and country.

TaskList.description: Retrieve blog posts from the Punto 61 API filtered by language (Italian) and year (2021).
Search for the Skype user using the email address robert.smith@hotmail.com to obtain their Skype ID and country.
